title: Field Hardware Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

Geotab is seeking a Field Hardware Engineer who will support GO Focus pilots by delivering rapid onsite product validation and diagnostic support at customer and pilot sites, validating, configuring, testing and troubleshooting camera and telematics hardware, and collecting reliable training data for Geotab's AI models. Reporting into Geotab's Video Product team, you will work with Video development, Field Service, third-party installers and Geotab resellers to make sure pilots work as intended. If you love technology and are keen to join an industry leader, we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

The Field Hardware Engineer supports Geotab's Video team by delivering rapid onsite product validation and diagnostic support for enterprise customers and pilot sites. This role validates, tests, and troubleshoots Geotab Video systems end to end, including camera and telematics hardware, connectivity, firmware and configuration, as well as creating and collecting material for training of Geotab's AI models.

The engineer supports pilots from pre-pilot preparation through completion, documents field findings, and helps generate controlled training data for new computer vision behaviors when customer footage is unavailable. This role requires strong practical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, safe vehicle operation, and a willingness to travel frequently to customer and test sites. Success in this role means pilots that work as intended. You act as the eyes and ears of the Video development team on the ground, representing Geotab and providing clear, reproducible evidence of what is happening in the field.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Travel to customer, partner, pilot, and test locations to validate and troubleshoot Geotab Video hardware.
  • Perform pre-pilot readiness checks, configuration, and validation to confirm Geotab Video systems are set up to work as intended.
  • Diagnose why a system is not working as intended, tracing symptoms such as video loss, missing events or connectivity drops across power, hardware, connectivity, SD cards, firmware and configuration.
  • Own assigned validation and diagnostic activities throughout the enterprise pilot lifecycle, from preparation through pilot closeout.
  • Work directly with customers, Field Service, third-party installers, resellers, and internal teams to diagnose issues, communicate evidence and coordinate resolution with the accountable owner.
  • Capture accurate diagnostic information, including logs, photos, vehicle details and steps to reproduce, document completed work, and communicate findings and next steps.
  • Escalate complex or recurring issues with clear technical details and supporting evidence, including Jira tickets for Video engineering.
  • Maintain readiness of mobile camera kits, tools, spare parts, and other field equipment.
  • Support controlled data-collection activities on designated development and test vehicles, including camera-kit installation, and safely staging and recording target driving scenarios.
  • Follow test procedures and data-collection instructions to produce reliable video footage and associated test-case information for the Vision team.
  • Identify recurring installation, hardware, or product issues and share field feedback with engineering, product, and support teams.
  • Act as the eyes and ears of the Video development team on site, representing Geotab professionally.
  • Support Video development with hands-on field and hardware work, such as prototype and accessory testing, when not supporting a pilot.
  • Route installation and service issues to Field Services with clear diagnostic evidence, and agree escalation contacts for each pilot.
  • Follow all applicable health, safety, privacy, security, and customer-site requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in related field may be substituted. Recent graduates with strong technical fundamentals are encouraged to apply.
  • Post-secondary certificate, diploma, or degree in Automotive Technology, Electrical or Electronics Technology, Mechatronics, Engineering Technology, Computer Systems, or a related field is preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 70% of the time, including internationally (United States and Canada).
  • Basic knowledge of vehicle electrical systems, wiring, power connections, or automotive electronics.
  • Ability to use hand tools, diagnostic equipment, test equipment, and installation materials safely.
  • Familiarity with MyGeotab or Jira is an asset.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues systematically and identify likely root causes.
  • Familiarity with vehicle-mounted cameras, telematics devices, GPS equipment, networking, or connected-vehicle technology is an asset.
  • Ability to read device logs and data to help diagnose issues.
  • Ability to follow detailed installation, calibration, testing, and data-collection procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to document technical work accurately.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating effectively with customers and internal teams.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, including vehicle bays, parking lots, customer sites, and outdoor locations.
  • Ability to safely handle customer and company equipment and maintain organized field kits.
  • Commitment to workplace safety, data privacy, and professional customer interactions.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

Geotab verifies candidates' eligibility to work in the United States through E-Verify, an internet-based system operated by U.S. Citizen and Immigration Services.

Other employment statements:

Geotab will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. Additionally, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the Company's legal duty to furnish information.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. Geotab provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Geotab complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Geotab expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Geotab's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. If you would like more information about our EEO program or wish to file a complaint, please contact our EEO officer, Klaus Boeckers at HRCompliance@geotab.com. description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Robotics Application Engineer – Rhoda AI GmbH (Germany)

About Rhoda AI GmbH
Rhoda AI GmbH is Rhoda AI's first international entity, established to own strategic partner relationships across Europe and drive deployment of Robotics as a Service (RaaS). It's a small, high-ownership team: you'll work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one, with a direct line to our engineering organization in Silicon Valley.

About the Application Engineering Team
Application Engineering is where Rhoda's AI meets the real world. We work directly with customers and strategic partners to understand their operational problems, determine where our platform can deliver value, and lead the application of Rhoda's AI model end to end — from model post-training and data collection, to robot tooling and work-cell design, to production deployments on the customer's floor. The team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, deployment operations, and business, with members in the US and Germany. Application Engineering is organized into three complementary roles — Application Engineers, Solution Engineers, and Technical Program Managers.

The Role
As a Robotics Application Engineer, you are a core member of Rhoda AI's European team and the hands-on technical lead in the early stages of a partner engagement — Scoping, Proof of Principle (POP), and Proof of Concept (POC) — through to RaaS deployment. You'll determine whether a use case is feasible, design and prototype the end effectors and task tooling a robot needs to do the job, write the data collection procedures that feed our models, and post-train Rhoda's AI model to perform the task. You'll spend real time on partner sites across Europe standing up POCs and showing what our platform can do.

You'll also serve as a key technical bridge between our European partners and Rhoda HQ Engineering, owning the feedback loop that turns field findings into product improvements.

What You'll Do

  • Scope new partner use cases alongside the commercial team: ask the right questions, assess technical feasibility, and make go/no-go recommendations.

  • Design, prototype, and iterate on end effectors and task-specific tooling for real-world manipulation tasks.

  • Author and refine data collection SOPs, and work with teleoperation and ML ops teams to gather high-quality training data.

  • Post-train and evaluate Rhoda's AI model on partner tasks, driving performance toward POC success criteria.

  • Lead on-site POP/POC setup and execution, including model training, daily reporting, validation, and direct partner interaction, and author the final technical report.

  • Partner with Solution Engineers on task engineering and solution design input as engagements move toward production.

  • Review proposals and provide technical feedback ahead of purchase orders.

  • Support model training through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), deployment, and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).

  • Lead root cause analysis for issues surfaced during deployments, troubleshooting across hardware, firmware, and software until the real cause is found.

  • Share field learnings with product and engineering in Silicon Valley, translating partner-reported issues into prioritized, actionable input for the roadmap.

  • Present clear, non-technical summaries of technical outcomes to partner leadership, and work with the commercial team to tie them to commercial milestones.

What You'll Bring

  • BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 3–8 years of hands-on experience in robotics, automation, systems integration, or applied engineering in an industrial setting, including real-world deployments or field installations.

  • Strong mechanical design skills, including CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion) and rapid prototyping (3D printing, machining, off-the-shelf components).

  • Working knowledge of machine learning workflows — data collection, training, and evaluation — and comfort working in Python.

  • Experience with robot arms, grippers, and sensors (cameras, depth sensors, LiDAR, IMUs) in real environments, including integration and calibration.

  • Proven track record conducting root cause analysis on complex systems spanning hardware, firmware, and software.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

  • Clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to partners, executives, and internal teams. Fluent English required; German at working level minimum.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 40% across Europe, including extended on-site POC periods, with occasional travel to the US.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with imitation learning, VLA models, world models, or robot foundation models.

  • Background in factory automation, material handling, or logistics.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (application, field, FDE, or sales engineering) at a robotics OEM, system integrator, or corporate automation department.

  • Familiarity with teleoperation systems or remote robot management workflows.

  • Experience with ROS/ROS2, embedded Linux, or C/Rust for onboard software.

Why Rhoda AI GmbH

  • Work on real customer problems, not lab demos: our robots are ready for field deployment directly after a successful POC.

  • Direct line to HQ Engineering — your field intelligence shapes the product roadmap.

  • Small, high-ownership team where you work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one.

title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

Our Core Technologies

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

What You'll Do

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For:

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have:

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You:

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

title: AI Fabric Architect
description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

What you will do:

  • Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric

  • Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many

  • Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables)

  • Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live

  • Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic

  • Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

  • Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

  • Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents

  • Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in data center or HPC networking, including direct responsibility for production GPU cluster fabrics

  • A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators

  • Deep expertise in InfiniBand (NDR/XDR, UFM, subnet management) and/or RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet

  • Strong command of rail-optimized and Clos/fat-tree designs, BGP/ECMP, and EVPN/VXLAN

  • A clear understanding of how fabric design and tuning affect collective communication and real workload performance

  • Comfortable automating with Python, Ansible, or similar

  • Strong Linux skills and the ability to debug across the boundary between host, NIC, and fabric

  • Sound judgment on tradeoffs between cost, performance, reliability, and time to deploy

  • NVIDIA Quantum/Spectrum-X, ConnectX-7/8, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and/or Broadcom Tomahawk 5-class Ethernet

  • 400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler AI infrastructure team, NVIDIA networking, or an AI factory integrator

  • Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design

  • Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks

  • Experience building out multiple sites in parallel or on aggressive timelines

  • Willingness to travel frequently to data center sites, especially during build-outs

What we offer at fal:

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • A lot of learning and growth opportunities

  • We offer relocation assistance to San Francisco.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

  • Regular team events and offsite

U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY INFORMATION:

fal provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Physical AI Infrastructure
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work alongside Physical AI customers, shape our core infrastructure products, and test ideas for what we should build next.
You will work with enterprises, ISVs, and digital-native companies running training, simulation, synthetic data, evaluation, and model serving workloads. By understanding their systems and helping them reach production, you will uncover requirements that inform our Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams. The goal is to connect needs across Physical AI industries with product decisions, including improvements that benefit enterprise customers more broadly.
You will also investigate opportunities for new Nebius products. You will develop hypotheses about unmet needs, examine demand and existing alternatives, and build prototypes to test with customers. Your findings will help determine which opportunities deserve investment and what an initial product should deliver.
The work is hands-on. You will write code, deploy and benchmark models, build agents, and troubleshoot infrastructure alongside customer engineers.

The position is part of the Physical AI go-to-market team, with close collaboration across customers, NVIDIA, Product, and Engineering.

What you will do

  • Work with customer engineers to understand their workloads, infrastructure constraints, and production requirements.
  • Translate Physical AI use cases into requirements that Cloud, Serverless, and Token Factory teams can use, backed by measurements and customer evidence.
  • Identify enterprise adoption barriers and common needs across industries. Work with Product and Engineering to assess gaps and test improvements with customers.
  • Build agents that set up, run, and debug Physical AI workloads, connecting them to clusters, schedulers, storage, and model servers.
  • Deploy and benchmark open-weight models with serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, then tune them for customer workloads.
  • Build prototypes and run technical evaluations to answer specific questions about performance, reliability, and product fit.
  • Assess demand and existing alternatives for opportunities outside current product teams’ scope, then build where there is a clear market.
  • Debug across Python, agents, model servers, Kubernetes, GPUs, networking, and storage. Turn successful setups into reusable scripts, deployments, and short guides.

What we are looking for

  • Three or more years in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, ML infrastructure, or similar, including ownership of a production service, cluster, or platform.
  • Experience working directly with customers or external engineers to scope problems, run evaluations, and explain technical tradeoffs.
  • Ability to turn an unfamiliar customer problem into concrete infrastructure requirements.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs or agents, at work or independently, with an understanding of their internals (e.g., transformers, KV caching, or tool calling) and how to evaluate their outputs.
  • Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure requirements, including identity and access management, network isolation, security, monitoring, and reliability.
  • Strong Python and Linux skills: you can read unfamiliar code, automate a setup, and debug from logs and metrics.
  • Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes, including configuration, networking, storage, and scheduling.
  • A record of getting useful software working with incomplete requirements, measuring results, and following through with the people using it.

Helpful experience

  • Enterprise customer engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or taking a new product from an initial customer problem to adoption.
  • Distributed compute such as Ray, Slurm, Spark, or multi-GPU jobs.
  • NVIDIA GPU workloads, including memory management, drivers, CUDA, NCCL, and monitoring.
  • Model serving with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI.
  • Robotics, simulation, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, world models, or tools such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, and Cosmos.
  • Infrastructure automation and enterprise integrations, including Terraform, CI/CD, private connectivity, and identity federation.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$179,500—$224,300 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Operations Expert with Python for AI Supply Chain Task Design
description:
Overview

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Did the work within the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

â¢ Tasks are reviewed by the client before approval



Please mention the word **EXELLENT** and tag RNDAuODYuMjkuMTY3 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNDAuODYuMjkuMTY3). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

title: Hosting Architect
description:
Job Overview:

The Hosting Architect will lead Fortrea’s enterprise transition from on premises datacenters to Hyperscaler, delivering a modern, resilient, and automated hosting platform that accelerates application delivery and business innovation. This role owns the target state Azure and hybrid hosting architecture, governs large scale cloud migration, and modernizes operations through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and AI driven operations. The objective is to increase speed to market, reduce operational friction, improve resiliency, and lower total cost of ownership. This is a hands-on senior architecture role with accountability for measurable business and operational outcomes, operating in a regulated enterprise environment.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Cloud Migration & Hybrid Architecture

  • Define and own Fortrea’s target‑state Cloud hosting architecture aligned to business and technology strategy.
  • Design and govern hybrid architectures during phased migration from on‑premises to Cloud.
  • Lead workload migration strategies (rehost, re‑platform, refactor, retire) to balance speed, risk, and value.
  • Act as the architectural authority for hosting and Cloud migration decisions.

Cloud Platform & Cloud‑Native Enablement

  • Architect Cloud platforms including landing zones, identity, networking, security, HA, and DR.
  • Establish standardised Cloud reference architectures and blueprints to accelerate application onboarding.
  • Enable self‑service, repeatable platforms that reduce delivery lead time for application and product teams.
  • Drive adoption of cloud‑native services to simplify operations and improve scalability and cost efficiency.

Automation, IaC & AI‑Led Operations

  • Implement an automation‑first operating model across hybrid and Cloud environments.
  • Build and govern Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Introduce AIOps and intelligent automation for predictive monitoring, self‑healing, and faster incident resolution.
  • Reduce environment provisioning time, manual effort, and operational cost through standardisation and automation.

Operational Excellence, Resilience & Governance

  • Embed resiliency, observability, and reliability engineering into all hosting designs.
  • Improve platform availability, reduce incidents, and optimise recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).
  • Ensure hosting platforms meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide architectural leadership across infrastructure, application, security, and compliance teams.

Value & Outcomes

The Hosting Architect is accountable for delivering:

  • Faster and safer Cloud migration at enterprise scale.
  • Reduced time‑to‑provision and change lead times for applications.
  • Improved platform reliability, availability, and recovery performance.
  • Measurable reduction in hosting OPEX through automation and cloud optimisation.
  • Hosting platforms that accelerate business capability delivery, not constrain it.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to present complex architectural concepts to senior leadership, technical teams, and non‑technical stakeholders.

Required skills (Minimum Required):

Core Experience

  • 10+ years in hosting, infrastructure, or cloud architecture roles.
  • Proven leadership of large‑scale Cloud migration programs.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise datacentre technologies and hybrid architectures.

Cloud & Cloud Expertise

  • Deep hands‑on experience with Cloud compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
  • Experience designing hybrid connectivity and phased migration strategies.
  • Cloud architecture and/or security certifications preferred.

Automation & AI

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code and scripting.
  • Exposure to AIOps or intelligent automation platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in reducing operational effort and cost through automation.

Professional Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑influencing skills.
  • Comfortable operating in complex, regulated enterprise environments.
  • Outcome‑driven mindset with a focus on business value and execution speed.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent professional experience in lieu of formal educational requirements.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

  • Remote-Based, as requested by the line manager

  • Work Timings: 2:00 PM IST to 11.00 PM IST

  • Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

title: Notion Systems Specialist
description:
This is a remote position.

Remote (India) | Full-time

Also searched as: Notion Developer, Notion Consultant, Notion & Automation Specialist, No-Code Automation Specialist, Workspace Systems Specialist, Business Systems Specialist, AI Workflow Specialist, Knowledge Management Specialist

Could you design a Notion system so clear that a remote team runs its week from it, and then automate the parts nobody should be typing by hand?

On a typical day you might map with a team lead how requests move between people in the morning, wire a Notion database to Slack and HubSpot so status updates post themselves after lunch, and before you log off, run a short training for a team in Australia on the tracker you built for them.

About Contour

We operate across three brands. The India team, which falls under the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building: it runs delivery, automation, people, and operations for the whole organisation.

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on Monday.com. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.

The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. The people who do well here care about that and want to know their work made a difference to those students.

They own their work end to end, start things without being asked, and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, including when something is off and what they have already tried, and write decisions down so the next person can pick them up. They give direct feedback and ask for it back.

The pace is fast. Small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle, and whoever spots the problem usually gets to lead the fix. We keep refining how we work, and you are expected to improve the processes you own.

We hire on what you have built and run yourself, and growth works the same way. Time with us counts, but scope, title and pay move with what you deliver and how much you raise the bar on what you own.

The GCC is being built now, seat by seat. This one decides whether the way teams track their work holds up as Contour grows.

About This Role

You are Contour's Notion builder. You design the databases, workflows and automations that teams plan and track their work in, connect them to the other tools Contour runs on, then document them and run the training until the new setup sticks.

Teams in India and Australia already keep trackers in Notion, but use is uneven, and much of it was set up by whoever needed it first. You sit in Business Operations and build for every team in the GCC: Operations and project coordinators, Customer Support, Academics and content, People and Finance, as well as the Australian teams they work with. The Internal Product team is your partner for anything that needs code. Teams tell you what they need to see; the build, the guides and the rollout are yours.

This is international work. Many of the people who rely on your systems sit in Melbourne, so you run trainings, answer questions and take feedback across the India–Australia time difference, in clear written and spoken English.

Two things separate a strong hire from a competent one here. First, you build for the person using it: someone new can find and change their tasks without a walkthrough, and a structure that only makes sense once you explain it is unfinished. Second, when a team copies data between tools or chases updates by hand, your first move is to automate it, with Notion's own automations, Notion AI, or Make, Zapier or n8n, and you measure what it saved.

This is an individual contributor seat: you manage nobody and work alongside the teams that rely on Notion. A build counts as finished once people use it, and a tracker nobody fills in is your problem to solve. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast.

When a workspace is clear, a lead sees what is open without calling a meeting, and a joiner learns how a team operates by reading it.

What You Will Do

  • Map the process before designing:Sit with each team to list what they track, who updates it and what each person checks, then settle the structure.

  • Design the databases:Link them with relations, rollups and formulas so each fact is entered once and appears wherever it is needed.

  • Set up views for every role:Give the requester, the person doing the task and the lead their own view, filtered to what they act on.

  • Automate the repetitive steps:Replace copying, chasing and hand-typed status updates with Notion buttons, database automations and templates.

  • Connect Notion to the rest of the stack:Use Make, Zapier, n8n or the Notion API to link HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace and Monday, so work moves between tools without anyone retyping it.

  • Put AI to work:Set up Notion AI and AI agents to summarise requests, draft SOPs, answer "how do I" questions from the workspace, and keep pages tidy, with a person checking what matters.

  • Write the guides:Document each setup in plain words: what it is for, how to add to it, and what to update when.

  • Run each rollout:Train teams in India and Australia in short live sessions and one to one, answer questions through the first weeks, and adjust what you made from what you hear.

  • Keep the workspace in order:Look after permissions, naming and archiving, and retire pages no one visits.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

We weigh what you have built and run more than the years on your CV. You should be able to point to:

  • A Notion workspace you designed and built for a team at work, which they ran their day from. Personal templates and course projects don't count here.

  • Automation and AI (essential):a manual step you removed with an automation, an integration or an AI step, using Notion automations, Make, Zapier, n8n or similar, and the time or errors it saved.

  • A guide you wrote or a training you ran after which people used a system without coming back to you.

  • A messy or abandoned setup you inherited and rebuilt, with the old records moved across intact.

  • International exposure (essential):systems you built, trained or supported for colleagues or clients in another country, ideally Australia, the UK or the US.

  • Excellent written and spoken English that a colleague in Australia follows first time, in a doc, on Slack or in a live training.

You know relations, rollups, formulas, templates and permissions well enough to see where a structure will break before anyone relies on it.

If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy hands-on building, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge management:a team wiki, SOP library or onboarding hub you built or ran, which people used and kept current.

  • Project management and coordination:cross-team work you ran or coordinated, with timelines, owners and status that stakeholders could rely on.

  • Scrum Master or agile delivery:sprints, stand-ups and retros you ran, with clean boards and data and clear progress updates for leads.

  • Notion API, webhooks or light scripting (JavaScript, Python or Apps Script).

  • HubSpot, Monday or Google Workspace administration.

  • Building custom GPTs or AI agents for a team.

  • An education or student-facing background.

What Good Looks Like

  • In daily use:the teams you set up keep their records current without anyone chasing them.

  • Easy to find:anyone can reach the current version of a page in one search.

  • Less manual work:the top repeat hand-offs between tools run on their own, and you can show the hours saved.

  • AI in the workflow:teams use Notion AI and the agents you set up every week, and trust what they produce.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, and comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience; we discuss it openly early in the process.

Ready to build the Notion systems Contour's teams run on, and automate what slows them down? Apply now.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. 

  • Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. 

  • Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. 

  • Apply Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration-as-code practices so Apple platform changes are controlled, repeatable and auditable. 

    • Security, Compliance & Observability 

  • Translate macOS security and compliance requirements into Jamf configuration profiles, automated controls and measurable outcomes. 

  • Automate macOS and third-party application patching, vulnerability remediation and exception handling. 

  • Build guardrails for FileVault, endpoint protection, authentication, privacy controls and device compliance. 

  • Create inventory, telemetry, dashboards and alerting that provide actionable visibility into automation performance, Mac health and risk. 

  • Partner with Security teams to automate evidence collection, audit reporting and remediation workflows for the Apple estate. 

    • Engineering, Lifecycle & Support 

  • Define the macOS and Jamf automation architecture, engineering standards and roadmap for a global Apple device service. 

  • Engineer automated packaging, deployment, update and rollback pipelines for macOS applications. 

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service. 

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services. 

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention. 

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively. 

    •  
     

    What you'll need

  • Jamf 300 certification. 

  • 4+ years of experience engineering and automating macOS services in a modern enterprise environment. 

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, smart groups, extension attributes, inventory, application deployment and API-based administration. 

  • Strong knowledge of macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, declarative device management and Apple security controls. 

  • Ability to build production-quality automation using shell scripting, Python, REST APIs and structured data formats, supported by Git, CI/CD, testing, secrets management, Jamf webhooks and code review. 

  • Experience automating macOS application packaging, deployment, patching and vulnerability remediation; a bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 

    •  

    Additional experience that would be valuable: 

  • Experience with identity integrations, Platform SSO, certificate services, zero-touch deployment and device trust. 

  • Knowledge of Installomator, swiftDialog, Nudge, or similar community and enterprise macOS automation tooling. 

  • Experience integrating Jamf with ServiceNow, asset-management, security, observability or data platforms. 

  • Cloud services, serverless functions, SQL or reporting technologies used to host integrations and analyse endpoint data. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Linux or mobile device management in a broader endpoint environment. 

    •  
     

     


     

    What we offer

    A competitive compensation package, of course.  

    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 


    Meet your team

    We’re Employee IT. We’re on a mission to deliver a seamless user experience for TomTom'ers across. Whether we're creating solutions to enable collaboration, increase productivity or help people communicate, your work will ensure TomTom'ers are equipped to create the first real-time map. In our team, you’ll help design, develop, deliver, operate and support solutions through a defined set of services, so that we can continue to bring people closer to the world around them.


    At TomTom...

    You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

    Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


    After you apply

    Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


    TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

    TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.
