title: Advance Pricing Analytics Actuary
description:
About Insify

We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. We offer the best insurance to our customers thanks to our focus on user experience, our leading underwriting services, and our expertise in data. In short, we’ve made getting insured quick, transparent and simple.

We know how to innovate - our team of seasoned entrepreneurs has built a host of successful businesses in fintech and e-commerce (HelloFresh, Bloomon and SumUp to name a few!).We’ve already raised over €25M in funding from leading investors (Accel Ventures, Frontline Ventures, Visionaries Club, Nico Rosberg, etc.), who love what we do and see the potential for a revolution in digital insurance.

We started our journey in the Netherlands and with our mission to make business insurance fast, simple and fair we have been able to have a significant impact on that market. Since last year we also serve customers in France and Germany, and are rapidly expanding across the rest of Europe!

How we work

At Insify, we’re building more than just an insurance company—we’re creating a culture that’s bold, caring, and built to make a real difference. Everything we do is driven by our core values: grit, impact, care, and entrepreneurship.

We show up with passion and perseverance. We solve real problems and put people first—especially our customers. And we’re always looking for smarter, faster, more human ways to do things.

That’s also why we’ve chosen a pro-office approach. We believe that working together, face to face, sparks creativity, builds stronger teams, and helps us learn faster—especially for new joiners. From spontaneous brainstorms to shared lunches, being in the same space makes the magic happen.

Joining Insify means being part of a team that truly backs each other and the entrepreneurs we serve. If you’re ready to grow, innovate, and help reshape the insurance industry from the inside out—we’d love to meet you.

Insurance Team

We’re the team making insurance work for everyone and everything. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions.

From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out.

About the Role
 
This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines.
 
We are a data-driven company and we don’t lose time on tasks with little to no value therefore, on top of modeling the risk, price elasticity, customer lifetime value, and other key business drivers and trends, you will also be supporting the full End-to-end automation, set up of proper data flows, tooling and overall pricing platform solution.

What you will be doing
  • Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth.
  • Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance.
  • Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), 
  • Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy.
  • Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products.
  • Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results.
  • Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition.

    • What you'll need
  • Actuarial diploma (or equivalent).
  • 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance.
  • Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation.
  • A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things.
  • Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key!
  • Fluent in English

    • Bonus points if you:
  • Have experience with both risk and commercial price modeling. +2 points if you also have experience with survival models. 
  • Master in Python and/or R and/or SQL
    • What we offer

    Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.
    Pension plan - participation to Insify’s Pension Plan, with 6% employer contribution.
    Travel reimbursement - we help travelers with their commute.
    Hybrid - Possibility to work from home two times a week.
    25 holidays days per year - (+ extra day on Christmas eve if it’s a weekday!)
    Subscription to Alleo - 50 EUR (net) monthly (cumulable) budget to spend on what you like - anything from gym memberships to UberEats!
    Company events - Monthly team drinks, quarterly offsites, lunch and learns, parties, merch and FUN!
    Company Macbook - get the best laptop to get your job done in no time!
    Quickly develop your career - there’s no better place to develop. We are growing and you can grow with us! Inhouse leadership programs and coaching
    High degree of autonomy - it’s time to ACTUALLY make an impact!

title: Engineer Software Defined Vehicle Simulation and Development
description:
NIKI is looking for graduates of Technical University Departments/Schools of Sciences/Engineers, or similar disciplines to support and develop complex system simulation processes of software-defined vehicles.

Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering!

If you have completed your studies or doctorate and are looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume.

Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress.

What to expect

  • Develop and optimize process and simulation methods for complex vehicle development in collaboration with international industry partners and research organizations.
  • Continuously monitor industry trends and advances in simulation technology to improve NIKI's services and drive innovation.
  • Coordinate our interdisciplinary projects in close cooperation with our customers.

Task Description

  • Modeling and simulation of complex systems and software functions. Focus on areas such as driving dynamics and autonomous driving.
  • Active cooperation with our customers. Programming of functions and algorithms for modern vehicle functions. Accompanying the process from the first idea to delivery.
  • Forward-looking development processes. Functional and vehicle development using the latest methods and tools, such as graphic modeling languages.
  • Empowering and coaching our clients.
  • Protection of software functions. Efficient implementation of technical security measures and criticality analysis of software functions.
  • Creation of test concepts. Development of automated test cases according to existing customer requirements. Test execution on the test bench or in road tests hedging concepts.
  • Development of new concepts for safeguarding networked systems (MIL/SIL/HIL) and also autonomous driving functions.
  • Development, commissioning, and testing of complex, multifunctional test benches.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality technical solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledge of modeling and numerical simulation of mechanical systems.
  • Familiarization with the application of simulation or design software tools.
  • Good knowledge of at least one of the languages: Python, Matlab or Java.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Spirit of innovation, initiative, and enjoyment of learning and tinkering.
  • Excellent command of English and technical terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the automotive industry, with a focus on vehicle development and simulation.
  • Initial knowledge of semi-formal modeling languages such as UML, SysML or Matlab/Simulink or initial experience in handling measurement technology or test benches, such as Vector, dSPACE, ETAS, or initial experience with control units and software in the embedded area.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Good command of the German language.

What we offer

  • Structured learning on the job, professional feedback, and a mentor open to all your questions.
  • Innovative, highly technically demanding industry and research projects, interdisciplinary teams, and highly qualified colleagues.
  • Open doors, and the chance to take over responsibility quickly - participate, shape, and leave your fingerprint.
  • Discover new talents and shape your career path: Become a specialist, project manager, or manager.
  • Simultaneous, collaborative work using modern digital platforms.
  • Workplace flexibility.
  • Flexible working hours thanks to our attractive flextime model - only compatible projects.
  • Enjoy working with great colleagues in your day-to-day work.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Legal Engineering Counsel
description:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

What weâre looking for

Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers.

This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster.

Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk.

What youâll do

  • Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review.

  • Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer.

  • Turn our legal counselâs nuanced advice, negotiation positions, and fallbacks into structured guidance that people and AI tools can apply consistently.

  • Test and measure what you build. Check outputs against real deals, track where the tools fall short, and iterate until they hold up.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts yourself using those systems â including customer agreements, BAAs, NDAs, payer trading partner agreements â from first redline through signature.

  • Structure our contract data so the team (and our tools) can answer questions about our agreements in minutes.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management. Build self-serve paths for routine agreements and field the questions that still need a person.

  • Take on new areas based on interest and business need as Stedi and the Legal team grow.

Who you are

  • Youâre bar-admitted and want to practice law while building the systems that support it.

  • BigLaw or in-house experience, ideally on transactional work, is a strong plus.

  • Youâve built with technology, whether thatâs AI workflows, prompts and evaluations, automations, scripts, or no-code tools, and you can show what you made.

  • Youâre comfortable working with structured data and technical tools, and you pick up new ones quickly. Coding experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You can explain complex issues in plain language, write clearly, and communicate confidently with executives, lawyers, procurement staff, engineers, and everyone in between.

  • Youâre comfortable with high-volume work, ambiguity, and shifting priorities, and you maintain high quality through effective habits.

  • You move fast, operate with precision, and follow through until the job is done. You thrive in an environment where clarity, accountability, and urgency matter. Youâre hungry to learn, seek out feedback, and put it to work.

Weâve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

  • All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.

  • If youâre unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to contact us directly at careers@stedi.com.

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

title: Account Development Representative I - DACH
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a German-speaking ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

 

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

 

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

What you will do:

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Fluency in German

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-JS1 #LI-Remote #DACH


What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • Germany: €58,800.00 to €120,500.00

  • United States: $91,000.00 to $181,700.00

  • United Kingdom: £57,200.00 to £116,400.00

  • Singapore: S$113,100.00 to S$209,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Engineering Intern
description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

  • The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently

  • If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice

title: Backend Software Developer
description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: External Wholesaler, Life and Annuity Distribution - West Coast Spanish Speaking
description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

The territory for this role is flexible within the United States.

Role Summary

We are seeking dynamic sales professionals to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for growing and developing strategic relationships with National Life Group’s distribution partners. Your focus will be on finding new business relationships and collaborating with existing strategic partners to develop and implement growth-oriented business goals. In addition, you will prospect and develop business relationships to drive sales of life and annuity products. You will form strong partnerships with agencies to ensure mutually beneficial relationships with an emphasis on customer service, business development, profitability, and retention. This role requires a relationship builder with a sales focus, excellent communication and presentation skills, strong work ethic, a passion for life and annuity products, and a competitive drive to succeed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for building new and growing existing relationships with agents and agencies to increase revenue from life and annuity sales.
  • Actively consult and advise agencies to provide them with value-added strategies to increase their book of business and create effective marketing campaigns to achieve growth goals.
  • Develop business plans in targeted markets to acquire, grow, and strengthen distribution relationships.
  • Establish and manage strong working relationships with internal and external partners to provide enhanced customer service for all sales and service operations.
  • Support agents and agency marketers in product selection, case design, and illustration fulfillment.
  • Conduct training, both in person and virtual, on products, processes, business development and services offered by National Life Group.
  • Onboard new relationships with National Life Group to quickly grow and develop business.
  • Maintain an active understanding of the competitive landscape and current industry trends to create innovative solutions designed to meet customer needs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) to effectively communicate with our partners.
  • An entrepreneur with a history of demonstrating year over year growth with strategic partners in life and annuity products.
  • Minimum 3 years industry experience in life and/or annuity product distribution. Preferred candidates will have 5+ years’ experience with a focus on indexed products and living benefits.
  • Preferred industry designations include CLU®, ChFC®, and CFP®.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, including the ability to get things done, breaking down barriers, and finding/executing solutions.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Strong organization and self-management skills, including managing travel and business expenses.
  • Ability to travel more than 50% of your time, growing and developing new and existing agency relationships.
  • Team player who can work with other field leaders and internal support roles to collaboratively develop business relationships.
  • History of success in a sales role, overcoming objections with creative problem solving and optimism to provide the best solution for customers.

AI Proficiency Expectations

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

  • Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.
  • Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.
  • Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life’s AI guiding principles.
  • Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention and intellectual property.

Benefits

Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range

Compensation for this role is earned primarily through commissions which are calculated as a percentage of life and annuity sales and pay guarantees may be offered for the first year of employment.

Additional Compensation and Benefits

The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. If hired, the employee will be in an "at-will position" and National Life reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

National Life is accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis and the role remains open until filled.

National Life Group® is a trade name of National Life Insurance Company, Montpelier, VT – founded in 1848, Life Insurance Company of the Southwest, Addison, TX – chartered in 1955, and their affiliates. Each company of National Life Group is solely responsible for its own financial condition and contractual obligations. Life Insurance Company of the Southwest is not an authorized insurer in New York and does not conduct insurance business in New York. Equity Services, Inc., Member FINRA/SIPC, is a Broker/Dealer and Registered Investment Adviser affiliate of National Life Insurance Company. All other entities are independent of the companies of National Life Group.

Fortune 1000 status is based on the consolidated financial results of all National Life Group companies.

  • Preferred industry designations include CLU®, ChFC®, and CFP®.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, including the ability to get things done, breaking down barriers, and finding/executing solutions.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Strong organization and self-management skills, including managing travel and business expenses.
  • Ability to travel more than 50% of your time, growing and developing new and existing agency relationships.
  • Team player who can work with other field leaders and internal support roles to collaboratively develop business relationships.
  • History of success in a sales role, overcoming objections with creative problem solving and optimism to provide the best solution for customers.

AI Proficiency Expectations

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

  • Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.
  • Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.
  • Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life’s AI guiding principles.
  • Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention and intellectual property.

Benefits

Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range

Compensation for this role is earned primarily through commissions which are calculated as a percentage of life and annuity sales and pay guarantees may be offered for the first year of employment.

Additional Compensation and Benefits

The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. National Life is accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis and the role remains open until filled.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Arpio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Arpio is building the next generation of disaster recovery (DR) for the cloud.

Modern enterprises face a growing list of threats to their cloud applications. With the increasing complexity of cloud-native environments, we know resilience to these threats is about more than just data. That's why, at Arpio, we have built a best in class SaaS offering that makes it easier than ever to protect your entire cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure from catastrophic downtime.

About the Role

Most companies don't think seriously about disaster recovery…until they have to. Ransomware hits. A cloud region goes dark. An audit looms. That's where we come in. As an Arpio SDR, you'll own the top of the funnel for a platform that protects businesses from catastrophic data loss across both AWS and Azure environments. You'll prospect into IT and security teams, surface the gaps in their current backup posture, and book meetings that turn into real pipeline. This is a role with real ownership and real influence on how we grow. Your work directly funds our next stage of growth.

What You'll Do

Generate Pipeline

  • Run high-volume, high-quality outbound via cold call, email, and LinkedIn, targeting IT Directors, CISOs, and infrastructure owners across AWS and Azure environments
  • Build and execute personalized multi-touch sequences tailored to DR-specific pain (Disaster Recovery): ransomware exposure, compliance deadlines, migration risk, and multi-cloud complexity
  • Qualify inbound leads quickly and accurately, routing the right opportunities to AEs with full context
  • Follow up on events, webinars, and content downloads to convert intent into booked meetings
  • Expectations: Maintain high daily call volume (150+ dials/day) and optimal call time to consistently achieve a target of 6 Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) per month

Run Sharp Discovery

  • Ask the questions that uncover real urgency like current RTO/RPO targets, last DR test date, compliance obligations, recent incidents, and which cloud platform(s) house their critical workloads
  • Map stakeholders across IT, security, and finance since DR decisions rarely live with a single person
  • Pass qualified meetings to AEs with documented pain points, stakeholder context, and relevant use case, not just a calendar invite; take end-to-end relationship ownership with Account Executives by attending booked meetings and driving joint success

Build the Foundation

  • Log all activity accurately in the CRM (HubSpot), maintain clean pipeline hygiene, and produce weekly reports detailing top-of-the-funnel additions and outbound activity campaigns to drive self-accountability
  • Test messaging, track what resonates, and feed insights back to marketing and leadership
  • Share what's working with messaging, objections, competitive intel, because the whole team moves faster when knowledge isn't siloed
  • Help build the outbound playbook from the ground up — including messaging that speaks credibly to Azure buyers as well as AWS buyers

Must-Haves

Experience & Background

  • Minimum 1.5 years of SDR/BDR, inside sales, or quota-carrying outbound experience in a SaaS B2B environment
  • Prior experience prospecting into or selling to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, security, or IT operations
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, networking) sufficient to speak credibly with IT and security buyers about cloud resilience; AWS or Azure familiarity is a strong plus

Skills & Competencies

  • Proven comfort with outbound prospecting including phone, email, LinkedIn, and multichannel sequences
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to educate and persuade diverse audiences
  • Proficiency with sales tools: HubSpot, Nooks, SmartLead, Walaxy (for LinkedIn automation)
  • Strong grit and analytical skills to evaluate outreach metrics, understand performance drivers, and optimize prospecting actions independently

How You Work

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. In this role it’s especially important that you:

  • Demonstrate grit and determination, with a willingness to embrace and navigate challenging situations with a strong drive to win and exceed goals
  • Are coachable, accountable, receptive to direct feedback, organized, and disciplined
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with high personal standards, urgency, and strong work ethic

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity: Base Salary plus Commission for each Sales Qualified Lead (SQL), Lead Kicker: A 25% kicker added on top of the SQL rate for any leads generated beyond 6, Monthly Champion Bonus, and Quarterly Champion Bonus if an SDR leads all three months of a quarter
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won't let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Arpio is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities; if you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know.

Job Description:

GDIT is activity recruiting to support Hosting, Operations and Maintenance (HOM) services for our Healthcare Integrated General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) program with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).


GDIT is looking for business subject matter expert who understands CMS business processes and systems to provide functional and financial reconciliation support to ensure top quality products are delivered to the customer.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Serves as a top-notch functional expert supporting one or more clients and user groups.
  • Analyzes current business processes, determining the scope and estimates for proposed enhancements or application upgrades
  • Expertise in Oracle EBS financial modules – AR, AP, GL, PO and ability to adapt to customizations
  • Provide subject matter expertise to review and guide the team for all business solutions in EBS system
  • Coordinates and manage the life cycle of the enhancement from requirement gathering to being deployed into Production
  • Adept with Agile practices and must collaboratively work in a team environment
  • Assist in reconciling General Ledger (GL) to subsystem data weekly throughout the month and daily during month-end closings. Provide documentation, distribute, and warehouse such data for subsequent review or audit.
  • Perform daily financial integrity checks and queries to identify, investigate, and report variances and issues.
  • Investigate reconciliation issues and variances and prepare corrective action documentation or log service requests or incidents to resolve the issue.
  • Support internal and external audit requests (including providing data extracts as needed).
  • Drive resolution of production incidents through analysis and coordination with multiple teams
  • Guide problem management activities and work with different teams to create fixes based on the root cause analysis
  • Performs business development activities, including providing technical solutions.
  • Deliver presentations and demonstrations to various stake holders including the customer and end user community

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent and 8+ years of Oracle EBS financial reconciliation experience, or Masters degree and 6+ years experience as described above.
  • Working experience with Oracle EBS / Oracle Federal Financials: GL, AP, AR, PO
  • Knowledge of basic Oracle SQL / PL-SQL – ability to write simple queries using TOAD
  • Knowledge of business intelligence tools

Preferred experience

  • HIGLAS knowledge is preferred
  • Knowledge of Oracle USSGL Accounting is a plus
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow Tool is a plus
  • Knowledge of Gitlab and Config Snapshot is preferred
  • Experience in a Federal environment, strongly preferred

LOCATION: Remote with occasional travel required for onsite meetings (approx once per month). Candidates in the DMV area strongly preferred.


CLEARANCE:

Ability to obtain a Public Trust: candidate must have lived in the United States at least three (3) out of the last five (5) years and pass a public trust background investigation.


* Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this position *


WHAT GDIT CAN OFFER YOU

  • Full-flex work week.
  • 401K with company match.
  • Customizable health benefits packages.
  • Collaborative teams of highly motivated critical thinkers and innovators.
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career.

GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. title: Full Stack Flutter Engineer – PHP/Go (m/f/x)
description:
Your mission

About SIDES

Restaurants are where people come together over good food. We build the technology that keeps them running.

SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. Thousands of restaurants run on it and millions of transactions flow through it every month, peaking on a Friday night when nothing is allowed to fail.

We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. And it is not just code on a screen: our software runs on real hardware in real restaurants, from POS devices to self-order terminals and more.

We love AI. These are wild times for software engineers, and we want to make the most of them: AI is part of every workflow at SIDES, and we are looking for people who are as excited about that as we are. Everyone on the team uses tools like Claude every day to write and review code, explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase, write tests and get from idea to shipped feature faster. We see it as a way to spend less time on boilerplate and more on what matters: good architecture, sound decisions and software that holds up on a busy Friday night. Nobody has figured all of this out yet. We experiment, share what works, drop what doesn't, and keep raising the bar together.

Our tech stack: Flutter (mobile & web), Go, PHP, and AWS

Your responsibilities

  • Deliver features end-to-end in a cross-functional team, from ideation and design to implementation, rollout and operations
  • Work across the entire stack, building Flutter experiences for iOS, Android, the web and self-order terminals, alongside Go and PHP backend services
  • Use AI tools such as Claude in your daily work and help the team improve how it works with them
  • Ensure operational quality through performance, security, reliability, scalability and observability, keeping ordering experiences running smoothly during peak service
  • Contribute to architectural and design decisions together with the team
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers through pair programming, code reviews and knowledge sharing
  • Help raise standards for testing, code quality and CI/CD
  • Build clean APIs, well-designed data models and user interfaces that stay fast during a busy service

Your profile

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer working on production software
  • Strong Flutter experience combined with hands-on backend development experience in Go or PHP
  • Ability and willingness to work across both frontend and backend every week, using Flutter, Go and PHP as part of a unified stack
  • Daily experience building with AI tools and curiosity about how they change the way software gets made
  • Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on quality
  • Solid understanding of MySQL, relational data modelling and API design
  • Experience with AWS and containerized deployments; Kubernetes is a plus
  • Ability to trace problems across the app, API and database, and weigh trade-offs beyond your own component
  • Independent, structured working style, with the ability to turn a rough problem statement into a tested, shipped solution without close supervision
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus

Perks & Benefits

Our Benefits:

  • A recipe for success: With over a decade of experience in the gastronomy and delivery industry, SIDES is known as a true specialist in this field. Join a leading player and help shape the future of the market.
  • Ownership & impact: We give you the space to bring in your ideas, grow your strengths, and take real responsibility. You’ll work independently while being supported by a strong and collaborative team.
  • High-quality work setup: Modern hardware, ergonomic workstations, and a professional office environment ensure you can do your best work.
  • Hungry for growth: Continuous learning matters to us. Through regular feedback cycles, we actively support your personal and professional development.
  • A positive workplace culture: Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, a trusting team culture, and our well-connected office in the heart of Berlin (Südkreuz).

Workplace Environment Perks:

  • Central office location in Berlin
  • Regular office and team events
  • Snacks and drinks in the office
  • SIDES Library
  • Dog-friendly workplace
  • Onboarding lunch to help you settle in and connect with the team

Your Benefits:

  • €50 monthly benefit allowance - your choice:
    • JobRad
    • Deutschlandticket
    • Company pension scheme (bAV)
    • Wellhub
  • Urban Sports Club: Discounted membership with access to fitness, classes, and wellness activities.
  • Instahelp: Professional mental health support, available whenever you need it.
  • INCENT & Corporate Benefits: Attractive employee discounts and exclusive partner offers.
  • Hybrid work: A mix of office and home office, depending on your role and team.
  • Flexible working hours: Working hours that fit your daily life and offer real flexibility.
  • December 24th & 31st off: Fully off without deducting vacation days.
  • Company events: Our annual highlights - the SIDES Summer Party and our Christmas Get-together.

title: Software Implementation Specialist
description:
About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

As an Implementation Specialist at 3E, you’ll turn a signed customer contract into a working, adopted solution. You’ll own hands-on implementation activities from kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and handoff—helping customers reach measurable first value from 3E’s products.

This role combines technical implementation, customer engagement, and project coordination. You’ll translate the agreed scope of work into a practical delivery plan, configure customer environments using real customer data, coordinate with technical and cross-functional partners, and keep milestones, risks, dependencies, and customer commitments visible throughout the engagement.

You’ll also support post-onboarding Value Realization Projects that help customers expand or improve their use of 3E through activities such as migrations, integrations, data remediation, inventory and catalog optimization, and workflow enablement.

You’ll work closely with the broader account team with clear ownership: the Implementation Specialist owns implementation delivery, the CSM owns ongoing adoption, and the AM owns the commercial account.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer interaction, takes ownership of outcomes, and is comfortable working through changing priorities and ambiguity. Those characteristics also connect authentically with 3E's broader EVP around building, operating through ambiguity, and moving between planning and execution.

Location: This position supports remote work within the UK.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead assigned customer implementations from internal handoff and kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and formal handoff.

  • Conduct implementation discovery and help confirm customer data readiness, environment requirements, security considerations, and integration prerequisites.

  • Translate the scope of work into a documented implementation plan with milestones, deliverables, dependencies, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.

  • Configure 3E customer environments, including inventory and structure, users and roles, integrations, and core workflows aligned with customer goals.

  • Work directly with customer contacts and administrators to validate the solution and deliver foundational training.

  • Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical specialists, and external implementation partners as required for delivery.

  • Track milestones and identify risks, dependencies, or potential scope changes early.

  • Follow established change-control processes when customer requests extend beyond the agreed scope.

  • Hold customers accountable for implementation commitments such as data readiness, resourcing, testing, and sign-offs.

  • Execute post-onboarding Value Realization Projects such as migrations, data remediation, integrations, inventory optimization, and workflow enablement.

  • Maintain accurate project records and documented handoffs while managing multiple concurrent implementations, keeping status, configuration, outcomes, risks, next steps, and training needs visible and prioritizing work based on customer impact, project risk, and key milestones.

  • Build technical proficiency across 3E products and work credibly with technical teams to troubleshoot implementation issues and identify risks; coding is not required.

  • Surface customer-identified bugs, product issues, and feature requests to the appropriate internal teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Required

  • 2-3 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.

  • Strong technical aptitude with demonstrated ability to configure software, troubleshoot setup issues, and learn new products.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects or implementations to deadlines and measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to translate customer requirements and agreed scope into clear implementation activities, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally and building productive customer relationships.

  • Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort working with data and systems of record.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and changing customer needs.

  • Willingness to travel 10–20%.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience developing or improving onboarding processes and customer journeys.

  • Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk.

  • Understanding of time-to-value, onboarding, adoption, or usage analytics.

  • Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software.

  • Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting customers across global markets.

  • This role must be based in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

 

Disclosures:

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us Candidate Privacy Notice

Agencies: 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

The Role

description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, ideally six figures or more, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-YW1 #LI-Remote #USEAST#USWEST

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
