title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

 

We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces.

  • Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development.

  • Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation.

  • Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance.

  • Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware.

  • Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation.

  • Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements

  • Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities.

  • Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior.

  • Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment.

 

What we would love to see from you

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems.

  • Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures.

  • Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent.

  • Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models.

  • Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response.

  • Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry.

  • Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial.

 

Skills and Behaviours

  • Methodical and structured approach to problem solving.

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor.

  • Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale.

  • Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve.

  • Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

title: Control & Estimation Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Innovation Internship
description:
About the role

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance.

As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

  • GHG reduction calculation: Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

  • Policy Fit: asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

  • Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

  • Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

  • Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Role Description and Responsibilities

The Pricing Analyst will be a key stakeholder in vendor rate negotiations and support pricing for tender opportunities. It will be responsible for maintaining tariff and number prefix lists for usage and rate refreshes surrounding changing costs. This role will also own customer facing pricelist templates and manage the governance process for negotiated pricing variations.

Required Skills and Qualifications

This role will work heavily with our suppliers, Billing and Sales Teams. Our ideal candidate is a detail oriented, results driven individual with strong communication skills and commercial acumen. Our Global business is positioned as a market disruptor with high growth potential, this role will have ample opportunity to drive improvement and learn new products and markets.

Pricing and Profitability

  • Develop and maintain pricing framework for determining margin incorporating vendor, network incorporating contention, and foreign exchange.

  • Define standard and floor pricing based on market-research and target margin levels.

Price Refreshes

  • Review cost changes and implement customer pricing refreshes to maintain margin levels.

  • Carry out regular international call pricing review and refreshes.

  • Project manage plan rationalization projects.

Prefix & Tariff Management

  • Develop and maintain tariff and call prefix lists for usage rating.

  • Incorporate and rationalize vendor tariff lists to deliver effective simplified rating.

  • Coordinate destination blocking from dial plans with Engineering for high-cost tariffs to minimize risk.

  • Manage tariff break outs based on vendor updates and/or high demand destinations where more granular rating is required.

Pricelist Templates

  • Develop and maintain customer facing price list document format(s).

  • Assign and manage stakeholders to ensure customer documents are appropriately populated and recorded.

  • Work with internal and external development resources to move towards systemizing customer price lists.

Rate Negotiation

  • Own customer rate variation governance process, ensuring appropriate stakeholder contribution and approver engagement.

  • Act as a key stakeholder in pro-active and re-active vendor rate negotiation.

Communication

  • Manage internal communication surrounding changing costs.

  • Manage internal and external Product communication surrounding changes and additions to catalogue.

  • Manage customer communication around pricing refreshes.

Project Management

  • Act as a key stakeholder for pricing components of product related projects.

  • Manage plan and rate rationalization projects.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain documentation of pricing framework and process.

  • Identify & implement process improvement and automation to improve capability and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Exceptional analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with data-driven decision making.

  • Strong initiative to drive improvement and automation.

  • Skilled with MS Office with advanced Excel.

  • Experience querying and manipulating data in a relational database.

Desirable

  • Products/Pricing/Telco experience.

  • Experience with prefix-based telco pricing.

  • Experience building and maintaining a database.

  • Business Analyst and/or Programming experience

  • Certifications in change management and/or project management.

Working Environment

  • Remote and Hybrid working arrangements available.

  • Occasional evening work may be required.

title: Product Designer
description:
A Omie tem como propósito trazer prosperidade para o ecossistema empreendedor brasileiro. Por isso, buscamos por pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, valorizando perfis que tenham capacidade de adaptação, senso colaborativo e sejam motivadas pela inovação e pelo aprendizado contínuo.

Faça parte da história de uma das empresas de tecnologia que mais cresce no país! 🚀

#VempraOmie

  • Atuar na estrutura de Product, focando no desenvolvimento dos melhores produtos internos para a organização.
  • Colaborar com squads multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvedores, tech leads e Product Managers, para garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades do negócio e dos usuários internos.
  • Mapear e entender as dores, anseios e objetivos dos usuários internos por meio de interação direta e contínua, aplicando técnicas de UX Research.
  • Conduzir processos de discovery utilizando a abordagem Double Diamond, desde a pesquisa inicial e ideação até os testes e a entrega final.
  • Prototipar soluções utilizando Figma, assegurando a aplicação de design systems e princípios de componentização para consistência e escalabilidade das interfaces.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos produtos internos, utilizando métricas para iterar e melhorar as soluções propostas continuamente.
  • Experiência comprovada atuando como Product Designer em produtos digitais.
  • Conhecimento em processos de discovery (especialmente Double Diamond), UX Research e aplicação de metodologias baseadas em dados para decisões de design.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, com capacidade para justificar e defender decisões de design com base em dados e melhores práticas.
  • Vivência em times ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em design system, componentização, hierarquia da informação e padrões de design de UX/UI.
  • Experiência comprovada atuando com Figma como principal ferramenta de prototipação e experiência em softwares complementares de design.
  • Familiaridade com motion design e edição de vídeo é um diferencial.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Marketing, Design, Publicidade, ou áreas correlatas.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
